subtopics.title: International Affairs and Places
subtopics.summary: This group covers a three-nation defence pact in West Asia, the NATO Ankara Summit 2026, the India-Bangladesh Ganga water sharing treaty and Nauru's new indigenous name. The pact and the summit both concern collective defence, while the treaty and the renaming concern shared resources and national identity.
facts: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement.
Türkiye described the pact as a defence-oriented partnership, not an alliance aimed at a particular country.
An armed attack on one member is to be treated as an attack on all three.
The pact is meant to complement existing regional and international security mechanisms rather than replace them.
The 2025 Pakistan-Saudi Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement was expanded into a trilateral framework.
NATO Ankara Summit 2026 followed the 2025 Hague Summit.
NATO members endorsed the Hague Defence Commitment to spend 5% of GDP on defence by 2035.
The 1996 Ganga Water Sharing Treaty is scheduled to expire in December 2026.
The Farakka Barrage is on the Ganga river at Murshidabad, West Bengal.
Nauru adopted the indigenous name Republic of Naoero to strengthen cultural identity and sovereignty.

subtopics.title: Governance, Welfare and Digital Safety
subtopics.summary: The Indian Statistical Institute Bill 2026 would change ISI's legal status and governance, with the President of India as Visitor. The NCDC (Amendment) Bill 2026 widens direct financing for cooperatives, and PM-VBRY supports first-time employment. Meta's new teen safety rules follow a settlement with 52 State Attorneys General.
facts: The Indian Statistical Institute Bill 2026 was introduced in Lok Sabha and seeks to repeal the ISI Act, 1959.
Under the Bill, the President of India would become the Visitor of the Indian Statistical Institute.
The Visitor can review functioning, order inquiries and issue binding directions.
The existing 33-member Council would be replaced by an 11-member Board of Governors.
The Director would be appointed by the Board with the Visitor's prior approval and would act as chief executive officer.
Under the Bill, central approval would be required only for the first set of regulations.
Parliament passed the National Cooperative Development Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 2026.
NCDC can now lend or grant funds directly to any cooperative society, subject to prescribed conditions.
PM-VBRY completed one year, and its implementation period runs from 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2027.
Meta plans default safety limits for teens, including a 2-hour cumulative daily limit across Instagram and Facebook.

subtopics.title: Awards, Science and Agriculture
subtopics.summary: This group covers the Fields Medal 2026, the COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal 2026 and India's new popcorn maize hybrid. The award items explain eligibility, frequency and awarding bodies, while the maize item places the crop among India's major food crops.
facts: The Fields Medal 2026 was awarded to Yu Deng, John Pardon, Jacob Tsimerman and Hong Wang.
Hong Wang became the third woman to win the Fields Medal.
The Fields Medal was established in 1936 through the efforts of John Charles Fields.
Fields Medal recipients must be below 40 years of age at the time of the award.
Two to four mathematicians may be honoured in each cycle, and the medal is awarded once every four years.
The Fields Medal is awarded by the International Mathematical Union.
Annapurni Subramaniam, Director of the Indian Institute of Astrophysics, Bengaluru, received the COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal 2026.
The COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal was established in 1990 and is awarded biennially.
The medal was conferred at the 46th Scientific Assembly in Florence, Italy.
India's indigenous, non-GMO popcorn maize hybrid seed was launched at Musunuru, Eluru, Andhra Pradesh.
